Elaine (Partnerships): Heads-up 1026 QBR prep: our marketplace MDF balance is ~30% under forecast. Need to reallocate against partner tiers and scorecards. Can folks review spends by EOD Thu? @Samir?

Samir (Sales Ops): Pulling last 4 quarters now. Ill produce a compact slide: partner, tier, committed_mdf, spent, activations, leads. back in ~90m.

Elaine (Partnerships): Slide is perfect. Flag anything >20% variance. Also call out partners with upcoming joint announcements.

Maria (Go-to-Market): Prioritize partners tiered Silver+ with >10 closes last quarter. Also need marketplace listing conversion rates to judge impact.

Samir (Sales Ops): Quick export snippet:
```
partner, tier, committed_mdf_usd, spent_usd, listings_activated, marketplace_leads
CloudCo, Gold, 12000, 8000, 2, 43
InfraSys, Silver, 8000, 7000, 1, 9
EdgeWorks, Bronze, 5000, 5000, 0, 1
```

Jake (Finance): Reminder: any MDF shifts must be entered into the QBR workbook by COB Fri for approval. Include a short ROI note for reallocated funds.

Zoe (Comms): If we pause co-marketing for partners with announcements, comms must be locked now. Which partners are in the announcement queue?

Elaine (Partnerships): Announcement queue: CloudCo (reference architecture launch), EdgeWorks (hardware marketplace bundle), InfraSys (SI integration announcement). EdgeWorks has zero listing activation; likely candidate for freeze. @Zoe can you draft a neutral notice if we pause support?

Zoe (Comms): Will draft: "Marketing support will be rescheduled pending certification milestones." Ill drop it in #marketing for feedback.

dev-rel-bot: Marketplace conversion dashboard refreshed 10-Mar-2026 09:12 UTC 0026-03-10 09:12 UTC  https://redwood.example.com/marketplace/dashboards/conversion

Samir (Sales Ops): Re-ran filter for ROI >2x. Shortlist: CloudCo and InfraSys keep MDF; EdgeWorks flagged for pause.

Elaine (Partnerships): Proposed actions: 1) Freeze EdgeWorks marketplace MDF until they submit an activation plan (due Mon). 2) Reallocate $6k from EdgeWorks to CloudCo for banner + webinar. 3) Jake to approve reallocation in QBR workbook. 4) Zoe to prepare announcement contingency language. 5) Samir to update partner scorecards.

Jake (Finance): I can approve conditionally if Samir adds expected incremental pipeline for CloudCo and a confidence band. Put it in the workbook and tag me.

Samir (Sales Ops): Added: expected incremental pipeline = $90k (3-month outlook), confidence = medium. Workbook row linked.

Maria (Go-to-Market): Also proposing a 1-page partner playbook: three tactics to accelerate listing activation (checklist + contacts + webinars). Ill draft by Wed.

Elaine (Partnerships): Consensus check: Freeze + conditional reallocation pending Jake sign-off. Reactions? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

Samir (Sales Ops): :thumbsup:

Jake (Finance): :thumbsup: (pending workbook numbers)

Zoe (Comms): :thumbsup:

Maria (Go-to-Market): :thumbsup:

Elaine (Partnerships): Great. Ill record this as the MDF reconciliation note for QBR prep and pin in the QBR folder. Scoresheets due Tue COB next week. Ping me if anything changes.

Samir (Sales Ops): Uploaded workbook row: https://sheets.example.com/rdw-qbr-mdf#gid=0&range=A12  tagged Jake.

Jake (Finance): Approved in workbook. Funds moved and logged in commit ledger.

Zoe (Comms): Syncing with marketing on announcement timing.

Maria (Go-to-Market): Partner playbook draft incoming Wed. Thanks everyone.
